items.title: Miniatures
items.detail: Four ’Mechs for Ridge Line, from a box set or your shelf. No minis yet? Coins work for a first game.

items.title: Two six-sided dice
items.detail: Roll on the table and type what you rolled. No dice? The app can roll for you.

items.title: Tape measure
items.detail: One that shows inches. Measure base edge to base edge.

items.title: A table
items.detail: About 3 feet across. A kitchen table works.

items.title: Free Quick-Start rules
items.detail: Optional reading from the publisher. You don’t need it to play Ridge Line.
